description:
## The Problem

Workouts are boring, espicially if you're doing it alone at your home. There is no one to cheer you, or pat your back when you complete a set successfully. 

## The Solution
EthFit offers a range of benefits to elevate your workout experience:
- Utilize your webcam to track your exercises, providing detailed analysis on your posture and stance.
- Infuse fun into your routine by gamifying workouts, connecting game moments precisely with your excercise movements.
- Earn exclusive NFT rewards for conquering challenging exercises and maintaining a consistent workout schedule.
- Keep your adrenaline pumping, maximizing your performance for optimal results.

how_its_made:
- Developing OpenCV models to accurately capture workout movements was the initial significant challenge in creating a proof of concept for our idea.
- Selecting the appropriate game that aligns perfectly with our criteria of matching exercise movements and fits within the hackathon's time frame was a critical decision point.
- Mapping a game intricately with the precisely captured body movements, which initially seemed straightforward in planning, presented its own distinctive and unexpected hurdles during implementation.
- Designing rewarding solutions for our gamified workout experience required extensive brainstorming sessions, often powered by caffeine to fuel creativity and problem-solving.
